The '''GH-22 blaster''' was a [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] used in the [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Vrath Xizor]] had a GH-22 [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] aboard his [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Razor (Dragonfly-class)|''Razor'']],<ref name="Deceived" /> around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="TEA">According to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', the end of the [[Great Galactic War]], which was concurrent with the events in ''Deceived'', occurred in [[3653 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
A GH-22 blaster appeared in [[Paul S. Kemp]]'s novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', which was published in [[2011]].<ref name="Deceived" />
